Evening reminder for regular visitors
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Travelers with pets should check in early and keep all animal papers ready for review.

Pet travel update

We are here to help make the trip smoother for you and your animal, from booking through pickup. Our team checks comfort needs, carrier fit, and any paperwork that helps the journey stay calm. If you are bringing a rabbit, <<FACT F082>>. Please bring the health certificate and other usual travel papers together so the desk can review them without delay.

For larger dogs, <<FACT F057>>. That note helps travelers plan ahead and avoid surprises at the counter. If your pet needs extra space, a quiet wait, or a quick welfare check, tell the desk team early so we can guide you in a simple way.

If you are unsure about carrier size, route details, or the best way to prepare your pet, stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.
